_about: Minimal full-strategy.json skeleton derived from kvn-phn/gtm-strategy-builder/examples/the-ledger/full-strategy.json. Copy this file to runs/<your-client>/full-strategy.json and fill in real evidence-grounded content. Field names match the gtm-strategy-builder make_deck.py expectations; other agent-pipeline repos may use slightly different names — always cross-check against the bundled examples in your target repo. Ground every field in real evidence (file:line citations, real numbers, real URLs). The anti-fabrication guard at the end of gtm-strategy-builder/copy-engine/FRAMEWORKS.md makes unearned proof points visible as [PROOF SLOT] markers; do the same thing by citing your sources.

gaps: Real gap, file:line cited in evidence
diagnose.evidence: Real source — file:line, URL, or wiki reference. e.g. README.md:1 or https://...

topGaps.summary: 1-3 sentence synthesis naming the most important gaps and their relative weight.

strategy.phase: Phase Name (Diagnose | Foundation | Demand Engine | Sales & Positioning | Content & Story | Measure — for gtm-strategy-builder)
strategy.findings: What this phase concluded. Cite real evidence.

recommendations.rationale: Why this matters, grounded in real numbers

builtPlaybooks.plan: Concrete steps to ship this playbook. Numbered or phased.

roadmap.roadmap: D30/D60/D90/D120/D180 milestone format works well. Each line should be one concrete ship + expected effect.

final: Recommended order + what to skip + the single biggest open question. This is the synthesis slide content.
